+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Prepare FastAPI release")
+    parser.add_argument("version", help="The version to release (e.g. 0.136.4)")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    version = args.version
+
+    # 1. Update fastapi/__init__.py
+    init_file = Path("fastapi/__init__.py")
+    content = init_file.read_text()
+    new_content = re.sub(r'^__version__ = ".*"$', f'__version__ = "{version}"', content, flags=re.MULTILINE)
+    init_file.write_text(new_content)
+    print(f"Updated fastapi/__init__.py to version {version}")
+
+    # 2. Update docs/en/docs/release-notes.md
+    release_notes_file = Path("docs/en/docs/release-notes.md")
+    content = release_notes_file.read_text()
+    
+    start_match = re.search(r'## Latest Changes', content)
+    if not start_match:
+        print("Error: '## Latest Changes' header not found in release-notes.md")
+        sys.exit(1)
+    
+    start_pos = start_match.start()
+    next_header_match = re.search(r'^## ', content[start_pos + 1:], re.MULTILINE)
+    
+    if next_header_match:
+        insertion_point = start_pos + 1 + next_header_match.start()
+        new_content = content[:insertion_point].rstrip() + f"\n\n## {version}\n\n" + content[insertion_point:]
+    else:
+        new_content = content.rstrip() + f"\n\n## {version}\n\n"
+    
+    release_notes_file.write_text(new_content)
+    print(f"Added {version} to docs/en/docs/release-notes.md")
+
+    # 3. Run scripts/add_latest_release_date.py
+    subprocess.run([sys.executable, "scripts/add_latest_release_date.py"], check=True)
+    print("Updated release date in release-notes.md")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
